Between Ascension Chronicle and Synchronicity Engine,
an unspoken pact
their echoes braid
An unspoken pact
and nothing is alone anymore.
A hidden relationship involving detail will surface and rewire the lattice.

Between Ascension Chronicle and Synchronicity Detector,
a hum only modules hear
the signal doubles back
A folded glance
and the organism breathes once.
